cover.alt: Three film frames show a seed becoming a sprout and a leafy plant on an amber-lit editing workbench, beside the headline A Good Frame Is Not a Finished Film.
cover.headline: A GOOD FRAME IS NOT A FINISHED FILM
cover.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original landscape editorial blog cover, approximately 16:9, for Framewright Studio Notes issue 02. Restrained charcoal, deep teal and warm amber palette. Premium cinematic miniature workbench: three linked film frames showing a seed, a small emerging sprout, and a mature upward leaf; beside them an amber pencil correcting a single frame, a compact film reel, and carefully organized archive boxes. Metaphorical editorial illustration, not a software screenshot and no existing artwork or brand logos. Right half: large beautifully typeset exact English headline, on three lines if needed: "A GOOD FRAME IS NOT A FINISHED FILM". Small but legible exact series label: "FRAMEWRIGHT STUDIO NOTES 02". Headline high contrast warm ivory, generous dark negative space, absolutely readable at reduced size. No additional words, no tiny interface text, no fake charts, no third-party references. Sophisticated tactile 3D illustration, subtle paper and metal textures, precise spacing and quiet lighting.
